title: Interim cross-team rota swap + exception log (Nov 2029)
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight ad-hoc sheet to track short-term oncall/rota swaps, coverage exceptions, and immediate action items for the next three weekends (Nov 2–17, 2029). Created to coordinate between SRE, Serving Runtime, and Customer Success while the regional capacity pledge contacts are being updated. Not intended to replace the canonical oncall schedule — use for swaps and exceptions only.

Summary metrics (current):
- Planned shifts tracked: 18
- Confirmed swaps: 6
- Outstanding swap approvals: 3 (need manager signoff)
- Coverage holes flagged: 2 (eu-west degraded and ap-south late-night gap)
- SLA exception events expected: 1 (bluejay rollout maintenance window)

Tracker table (columns):
Date range | Primary | Backup | Region | Coverage window (UTC) | Exception type | Notes / reason | Action required | Approver | Status | Last update
2029-11-02 18:00–2029-11-03 06:00 | Marcus O'Connor | Evelyn Zhao | eu-west-1 | 18:00–06:00 | Reduced capacity | Planned infra maintenance on dedicated pool (PR #1476) — expected 30% throughput drop for large-context models | Coordinate canary fallback to cpu-fallback pool; notify CS customers with SLA clause | SRE lead (Carlos) | confirmed | 2029-11-04
2029-11-09 22:00–2029-11-10 10:00 | Priya Raman (swap pending) | Sana Iqbal | ap-south-1 | 22:00–10:00 | Coverage gap | No permanent night oncall in AP for this weekend — volunteer swap requested from serving-runtime | Approve swap, assign backup, confirm contactability via slack channel #ap-oncall | Product ops manager | pending | 2029-11-03
2029-11-16 00:00–2029-11-16 12:00 | Evelyn Zhao | - | us-west-2 | 00:00–12:00 | None | Normal coverage — Evelyn covers both primary and fallback through capacity routing | None | N/A | confirmed | 2029-11-01
2029-11-03 02:00–2029-11-03 08:00 | Volunteer pool (on-call rota) | Marcus O'Connor | global | rolling | Incident-prone window | Low token quota threshold observed in hosted API for small customers early morning — potential false-positive quota spikes post-deploy | Add quota-monitoring alert (ENG-4821), owner: Marcus. Temporary token throttle disabled for experiment. | Platform-eng manager | partially_confirmed | 2029-11-04

Outstanding exceptions (details):
- Bluejay rollout (maintenance): scheduled 2029-11-02 19:00–21:00 UTC. Affects dedicated pools in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Expected impact: slowdowns for >8k token streams; automated fallback to smaller-context variants in routing policy recommended. CS communications draft in /Confluence (linked). Owner: Carlos.
- AP night coverage: recruiting volunteer for 2029-11-09—no fallback assigned yet. Product ops to escalate to team leads by 2029-11-05.

Swap request log (mini):
- Priya <-> Evelyn (2029-11-09): Priya requested swap because of travel; Evelyn tentatively agreed but needs manager signoff (Sana). Action: Sana to approve by 2029-11-05.
- Marcus -> Volunteer pool (2029-11-03): Marcus covering fallback; volunteer pool to pick up primary if incident escalates. Action: SRE to confirm volunteer roster.
- Temporary backfill: Hiring contractor 'oncall-temp-2' authorized for single weekend only (HR confirmation attached in Confluence).

Quick checks & decision points (to be resolved before Friday 2029-11-08):
- Confirm manager approvals for pending swaps (owners: Sana, Carlos) — DONE/IN-PROGRESS tick column to be updated.
- Ensure fallback routing rule for bluejay maintenance is staged and smoke-tested (owner: Marcus) — smoke test scheduled 2029-11-02 15:00 UTC.
- CS outbound: finalize short message for impacted customers with <3h notice option (owner: Priya).

Action items (short):
- [ ] Sana: Approve/deny Priya <-> Evelyn swap by 2029-11-05.
- [ ] Marcus: Post smoke-test result in this doc and #sre-ops by 2029-11-02 16:00 UTC.
- [ ] Carlos: Confirm dedicated pool maintenance window and update linked PR.
- [ ] Product-ops: Patch oncall roster with temporary contacts and upload to Confluence after approvals.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: If fallback routing fails, latency SLOs could be missed for long-context customers — Mitigation: enable cross-region fallback (us-east-1) and reduce batch sizes for large-context generation during window.
- Risk: Manual swap approvals cause gaps if managers are slow — Mitigation: allow emergency self-assign for single weekend with post-hoc approval by risk owner.

Notes / decisions log (chronological):
2029-11-01: Created by Priya to consolidate swap requests and exceptions coming from #oncall-requests slack.
2029-11-03: Carlos confirmed bluejay maintenance; added note to coordinate CS messaging.
2029-11-04: Marcus ran smoke tests (results: fallback route OK, slight increased p99 tail).

How to use this sheet: copy rows into canonical oncall schedule after approvals. Keep this doc as the single source for swap approvals for the indicated weekends only. For anything beyond Nov 17, create a new tracker.

Related links (quick):
- Canonical oncall schedule: Confluence > Oncall Roster (link in linked_artifacts)
- Incident runbook: /playbooks/oncall/runbook
- Swap request form (internal): https://forms.internal.redwood/rota-swap

Owner notes (Priya):
- This is intentionally lightweight. Please prefer short bullet updates in the status column. If you edit rows, add your initials and date in the Last update column. If you escalate, add the Jira ticket ID in 'Exception type' and push to linked_artifacts.

End of sheet.
